87:t_1:5.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「...Do you really have to go?」

87:t_1:7.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Why won't you take me with you?」

87:t_1:8.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Please understand, Miss $$ソシエ$$. This battle is different from any we've fought so far.」

87:t_1:9.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「I've been fighting alongside $$ロラン$$ this whole time! Even in the biggest battles before, we survived, didn't we!」

87:t_1:10.en:
$$メシェー$$
「Cut it out, $$ソシエ$$. $$ロラン$$ is only doing this because he's thinking of you...」

87:t_1:11.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Stay out of it, $$メシェー$$!」

87:t_1:13.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Give me a reason, $$ロラン$$! Why is it?!」

87:t_1:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...I understand you want to fight as part of the Resistance, Miss $$ソシエ$$...」

87:t_1:15.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But if we keep going down that path, a more terrifying battle than any before is waiting at the end of it.」

87:t_1:17.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「What is that supposed to mean?! Did you get a revelation in a dream or something?!」

87:t_1:18.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...The $$ホワイトドール$$... is telling me so...」

87:t_1:20.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I can't explain it well, but when I ride the $$ホワイトドール$$ and fight the $$サイデリアル$$, I can feel that.」

87:t_1:21.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「That's enough! You're just being pushed around by a mechanical doll!」

87:t_1:23.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Then don't go! If it's such a dangerous fight, $$ロラン$$ doesn't have to go either!」

87:t_1:25.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I was entrusted with the $$ホワイトドール$$ by $$ディアナ$$.」

87:t_1:26.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「What?! You can listen to $$ディアナ$$, but you can't listen to me?!」

87:t_1:27.en:
$$キエル$$
「That's enough of that, $$ソシエ$$.」

87:t_1:28.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Fine! If you want to go, go wherever you like! As of today, you're fired, $$ロラン$$!」

87:t_1:29.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...Thank you for everything you've done for me.」

87:t_1:31.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Miss $$キエル$$... Please look after Miss $$ソシエ$$.」

87:t_1:32.en:
$$キエル$$
「I am the head of the $$ハイム$$ family now. I decide whether our servants are employed.」

87:t_1:33.en:
$$キエル$$
「$$ロラン$$... You must come back alive.」

87:t_1:36.en:
$$メシェー$$
「I understand how you feel too, $$ソシエ$$. But this time, of all times...」

87:t_1:37.en:
$$キエル$$
「$$ソシエ$$... Think about how $$ロラン$$ feels, too...」

87:t_1:40.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「$$ロラン$$... You have to come back... No matter what shape you're in, you have to...」

87:t_1:41.en:
$$キエル$$
(...$$ディアナ$$... Just as you force a harsh road on $$ロラン$$, are you tormenting yourself as well...?)

87:t_1:42.en:
$$キエル$$
(...$$ディアナ$$... Please, may your heart be at peace...)

87:t_1:46.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Good work, Sis $$レイカ$$. Thanks for playing guide.」

87:t_1:47.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Good work to you two as well, $$トッポ$$ and $$ビューティ$$. How's the situation?」

87:t_1:48.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「The leaders of every Resistance group have gathered. They're all raring to go.」

87:t_1:49.en:
$$リリ$$
「So this is the group that will form the core of the coming operation.」

87:t_1:51.en:
$$リリ$$
「I am $$リリ・ボルジャーノ$$, the Resistance's representative. Pleased to make your acquaintance.」

87:t_1:52.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Forgive my rudeness. I am Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$.」

87:t_1:53.en:
$$リリ$$
「Please don't worry about it. I'm used to people being surprised.」

87:t_1:54.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Still, Miss $$リリ$$'s judgment, her negotiating skill... and her charisma make her fit to be our leader.」

87:t_1:55.en:
$$リリ$$
「Thank you. However, I'll leave the front lines to all of you.」

87:t_1:56.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Understood. We'll take care of the operation briefing.」

87:t_1:57.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We are $c, an independent unit from $$蒼の地球$$. We're counting on you.」

87:t_1:58.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「We know a fair bit about you.」

87:t_1:60.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「I'm from the $$ＵＣＷ$$, you see. I remember the $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ battles.」

87:t_1:61.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「I'm from the $$ＡＤＷ$$, but the exploits of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ gave me courage time and again.」

87:t_1:62.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「$$ビューティ$$ told us you're something like a combined force of that $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

87:t_1:63.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「That's why we've staked everything on this operation that you're joining.」

87:t_1:65.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Still, having expectations placed on us is not a bad thing.」

87:t_1:66.en:
$$マオ$$
「Everyone will say that answering them is what makes us $c.」

87:t_1:67.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's right. There's nothing for it but to do it.」

87:t_1:68.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Morale in every unit is high. Keeping up this momentum, we will take $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

87:t_1:69.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Then I'll explain the situation. After that, let's decide on each team's placement.」

87:t_1:70.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
(The $$セントラル・ベース$$, where the $$レイライン$$s of the $$アメリア$$ Continent converge... Will this battle decide the course of the war on $$翠の地球$$...?)

87:t_1:74.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

87:t_1:75.en:
$$アルト$$
「...So $$翠の地球$$ has $$レイライン$$s stretched across it, just like $$蒼の地球$$...」

87:t_1:76.en:
$$マオ$$
「On $$蒼の地球$$, the $$レイライン$$s converge on the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$, but...」

87:t_1:77.en:
$$マオ$$
「Here, they converge on the $$ターミナル・ベース$$s in each region, and those in turn converge on the large-scale bases on each continent.」

87:t_1:78.en:
$$宗介$$
「So that's the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

87:t_1:79.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$翠の地球$$ had no unified body like the $$連邦政府$$, so even control by scattered regional bases could cover the whole land once the net spread wide enough.」

87:t_1:80.en:
$$マオ$$
「But flip that around, and each of those points has little strength of its own, so if we defeat them one at a time, over and over, we can break the enemy's ruling system.」

87:t_1:81.en:
$$宗介$$
「To do that, we'd need to cut the connections between the points... in other words, break the enemy's control, then.」

87:t_1:82.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's exactly why we're taking the $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

87:t_1:83.en:
$$マオ$$
「The $$セントラル・ベース$$ governing the north of the Central Continent, the largest continent on $$翠の地球$$, has already been taken by the Earth side.」

87:t_1:84.en:
$$マオ$$
「They say even the $$サイデリアル$$, who have the advantage in strength, are being forced into an even fight with the Resistance because their chain of command got split.」

87:t_1:85.en:
$$甲児$$
「So the $$セントラル・ベース$$ is the linchpin of the $$サイデリアル$$'s strategy.」

87:t_1:86.en:
$n
「And if we seize it, we can shut down the $$レイライン$$s and stop the extraction of $$次元力$$, too.」

87:t_1:87.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's two birds with one stone for us.」

87:t_1:88.en:
$$レド$$
「What is the plan of attack?」
